title: The UltraTech–Grasim consolidation of Indian cement
statement: Under KM Birla, the group restructured cement holdings into UltraTech and executed successive acquisitions — including the 2010 Samruddhi swap and later the Binani and China-assets purchases — driving toward national scale.
outcome: UltraTech became India's largest and among the world's most efficient cement producers, the model of the Birla modernization era.

title: Hindalco's Novelis acquisition — $6 billion of aluminum downstream
statement: Birla bought the Atlanta-based aluminum-rolling giant Novelis for roughly $6 billion, at that time the largest overseas acquisition by an Indian company, moving Hindalco out of commodity upstream volatility.
outcome: Novelis's beverage-can franchises and recycling platform cushioned Hindalco through the post-2008 crash; the deal is cited as the moment the Aditya Birla group became a global materials player.
